questions.questionText: What are characteristics of all living organisms?

Using the binomial system, the name of a lion is Panthera leo.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The lion belongs to the kingdom Panthera.
The lion belongs to the genus Panthera.
The lion belongs to the species Panthera.
The lion belongs to the genus leo.

questions.questionText: Which feature would place organisms into the crustacean group of arthropods?

options.text: usually have two pairs of wings

Glycogen is a large molecule made from smaller molecules.

What is a use of the carbohydrates made by photosynthesis?

options.text: to produce cellulose for energy stores
to produce starch to build cell walls
to produce starch for transport in the phloem
to produce sucrose for transport in the phloem

options.text: a system of blood vessels with the arteries returning blood to the heart
a system of blood vessels with a pump and valves to ensure one-way flow of blood
blood flows away from the heart into the vena cava
blood flows into the lungs from the pulmonary vein

Which statement about anaerobic respiration is correct?

options.text: Anaerobic respiration requires oxygen and releases less energy per glucose molecule than aerobic respiration.
Anaerobic respiration requires oxygen and releases more energy per glucose molecule than aerobic respiration.
Anaerobic respiration does not require oxygen and releases less energy per glucose molecule than aerobic respiration.

questions.questionText: What is an example of a population?

options.text: all the animals and plants living in a lake
all the different herbivores in a forest
all the mahogany trees growing in a forest

questions.questionText: Which statement about antibiotics is correct?

options.text: Antibiotics are produced by white blood cells.
Antibiotics can become resistant to bacteria.

questions.questionText: What is the correct description of asexual reproduction?

options.text: Genetically different offspring are produced from one parent.
Genetically different offspring are produced from two parents.
Genetically identical offspring are produced from one parent.
Genetically identical offspring are produced from two parents.

tusks
